solution:
Let $A=\tan^{-1}\dfrac12$ and $B=\tan^{-1}\dfrac13$. Then
$$\tan(A+B)=\dfrac{\frac12+\frac13}{1-\frac16}=1.$$
Since $A,B>0$ and $A+B<\dfrac{\pi}{2}$, we get $A+B=\dfrac{\pi}{4}$. (B)
